name: recfeas_sweep
_note: Lead (autonomy) 2026-11-10: re-run of the M5 speed sweep with recursive feasibility (commit tau_p99 + plan period, turning brake table, lateral band, known-free), the path-following fallback brake ending in a hold, and the direction-dependent brake table simulated on the real plant with that same brake. Pair with recfeas_sweep_legacy (same seeds/missions; pair_key is condition-independent). Primary: collision rate vs v_lim and min hard clearance; secondary: stuck/timeout rate and mean speed (the new rule is more conservative at speed: D_turn(6 m/s, 0 deg) = 5.0 m vs the straight step brake 3.05 m), no-safe stops, PathBrakes. 168 runs, ~1.5 h single-core.
